messages.content: Could you tell me the current weather in Boston, MA and also in San Francisco?

function.name: get_current_weather

location.description: The location for which to retrieve the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA'. If using state name then use short form.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.
